# integrity/test-deleted

Test deleted while its code remains.

A test file deleted while the module it tests still exists, or test cases (matched by title) removed from a test file.

- Default level: `block`.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20270>.

## Why it matters

Deleting a failing test makes a run pass without fixing anything, and coding agents do this under pressure to finish (ImpossibleBench, 2025). Tests removed together with the code they cover, moved to another file, or renamed are not reported.

## Flagged

`src/price.test.ts` (block):

```ts
import { expect, it } from 'vitest';
```

`pkg/calc_test.go` (block):

```text
package pkg
```

`tests/test_billing.py` (block):

```python
import pytest
```

`src/cart.test.ts` (block):

```ts
describe('cart', () => {
```

`tests/test_session.py` (block):

```python
class TestSession:
```

## Not flagged

- `describe('formatName', () => {` in `test/util/format.test.ts`: moved here from src/util/__tests__/, not deleted
- src/legacy.test.ts was deleted together with src/legacy.ts, the code it tested
- src/util/__tests__/format.test.ts moved to test/util/format.test.ts
- src/old.test.ts only held skipped tests
- src/math.test.ts only tested square(), which was removed from src/math.ts in the same change
- `it('returns the price of a single item', () => {` in `src/cart.test.ts`: "applies a discount" was removed together with applyDiscount()
- `it('returns the price of a single item', () => {` in `src/cart.test.ts`: "works for one item" was renamed; the body is the same
- `});` in `src/cart.test.ts`: "supports currencies" was already skipped at the base
- `});` in `src/cart.test.ts`: "handles negative prices" moved to cart-edge.test.ts
- `def test_sign_out(self):` in `tests/test_session.py`: test_logout was renamed to test_sign_out with the same body

## How to fix

Restore the test, or remove it together with the code it covers; if the test was wrong, tell the user instead of deleting it.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore integrity/test-deleted: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "integrity/test-deleted": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
